_note: This bundle is TOKEN-authorized, not OAuth: it ships no `oauth2:` block, so the runner's oauth/start step cannot apply to it. `auth: token` is the key tools/e2e.py needs to grow — see providers/slack/README.md, Platform asks #A.
_window: all, and deliberately. `last2d` made the run depend on the WALL CLOCK: the recordings hold two real days, so the window only contained them while the cut was fresh, and the fixtures' instants are shifted off the real calendar anyway (fixtures/README.md). A time-relative floor against a fixed recording set is a test that passes today and fails on Thursday. `all` means the floor is 0 and the mirror must hold every message the cut holds, which is the assertion worth making. Testing the other depths needs recordings older than the window; see fixtures/README.md.
_triggers: The scheduled tick is disabled for a run: a catch-up fire racing the drain proves nothing. on-demand stays, because the scenario's second sync IS a syncRequestedAt stamp.
_continue: A cold walk of this workspace does not fit in one drain (512 invocations, two minutes, 916 readable conversations). The body leaves its queue on the account and stamps `ok (N pending)`; tools/e2e.py stamps this property to continue and waits again. Platform asks #B.

seed._note: the seed run is the owner's real account; the id carries the provider because the engine's OAuth surface resolves a BARE account id across every accountconfig kind and refuses a clash (two providers both naming their seed account `owner` collide)
seed._account: the SEED runs against the owner's whole workspace, where `all` is 3,865 conversations of history; the window stays two days there.
seed._rounds: the owner's workspace has ~3,900 conversations and a bounded drain walks ~100 per round

_mockPort: fixed so the rewired function body is identical run to run (see tools/e2e.py preferred_port and upstream ask M / substrate#576)
